Pipelines endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=success}} {{ds:component/chip|label=Stable|variant=success}}

Create and manage pipelines programmatically. Base URL: https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Version 3 is current|body_html=

v3 is the latest version of the pipelines endpoint. If you're on v2, consider upgrading for new features and improvements. View the v2 documentation if you're still using the previous version.

}}

Create a pipeline

POST /v3/pipelines

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=namestringYesHuman-readable pipeline name, unique per workspace.source_connector_idstringYesID of the connector events are read from.destination_connector_idstringYesID of the connector events are written to.transformsarrayNoOrdered list of transform step definitions. Omit for a pass-through copy.schedulestringNoCron expression. Omit for event-triggered (streaming) pipelines.tagsobjectNo[NEW in v3] Arbitrary key-value metadata for organizing and filtering pipelines.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v3/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "ingest-orders", "source_connector_id": "conn_pg_orders", "destination_connector_id": "conn_snowflake_dw", "tags": { "team": "analytics", "env": "prod" } }}}

List pipelines

GET /v3/pipelines — cursor-paginated, see Rate limits for the pagination envelope. Query parameters: tag_filter to find pipelines by tag.

Pipeline states

Returned pipelines include a state field of draft, active, or paused — see Pipelines for what each means.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Deleting a pipeline|body_html=

Deleting a pipeline does not delete its source or destination connectors, and does not delete events already written to the destination. In-flight runs are allowed to finish before deletion completes.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=

  • List pipelines
  • Pipeline states

Pipelines endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=danger}} {{ds:component/chip|label=Deprecated|variant=danger}}

Create and manage pipelines programmatically. Base URL: https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=This is v2 — v3 is now current|body_html=

v2 is no longer recommended for new integrations. v3 includes new features like pipeline tagging. All v2 endpoints remain supported for backward compatibility, but we encourage existing users to migrate to v3. View v3 documentation or read migration notes below.

}}

Create a pipeline

POST /v2/pipelines

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=namestringYesHuman-readable pipeline name, unique per workspace.source_connector_idstringYesID of the connector events are read from.destination_connector_idstringYesID of the connector events are written to.transformsarrayNoOrdered list of transform step definitions. Omit for a pass-through copy.schedulestringNoCron expression. Omit for event-triggered (streaming) pipelines.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "ingest-orders", "source_connector_id": "conn_pg_orders", "destination_connector_id": "conn_snowflake_dw" }}}

List pipelines

GET /v2/pipelines — cursor-paginated, see Rate limits for the pagination envelope.

Pipeline states

Returned pipelines include a state field of draft, active, or paused — see Pipelines for what each means.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Deleting a pipeline|body_html=

Deleting a pipeline does not delete its source or destination connectors, and does not delete events already written to the destination. In-flight runs are allowed to finish before deletion completes.

}}

Upgrading to v3

v3 is backward compatible with v2 but adds:

  • Pipeline tagging: Organize pipelines with arbitrary metadata tags for easier discovery and filtering.
  • Better filtering: Filter pipelines by tag using the tag_filter query parameter on GET /v3/pipelines.

See the v3 documentation for the full endpoint reference.

{{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Create a pipeline
  • List pipelines
  • Pipeline states
  • Upgrading to v3
    • }}

Events endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v3|variant=primary}} {{ds:component/chip|label=Stable|variant=success}}

Query and replay events that have flowed through a pipeline.

List events

GET /v3/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events — cursor-paginated, filterable by type, status, and occurred_at range. v3 adds status filtering for better event lifecycle visibility.

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=typestringNoFilter to a single event type, e.g. order.created.statusstringNoFilter by event status: success, failed, pending.sincestringNoISO-8601 timestamp lower bound on occurred_at.cursorstringNoOpaque pagination cursor from a previous response's next_cursor.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=event.json|language=json|code={ "id": "evt_8f2c1a90", "type": "order.created", "status": "success", "occurred_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:44Z", "processed_at": "2026-08-18T09:12:45Z", "payload": { "order_id": "ord_4471" } }}}

Replay an event

POST /v3/events/{id}/replay — re-runs an event that failed or exhausted retries. v3 allows selective replays for any event, not just dead-lettered ones, with automatic retry logic.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Platform events|body_html=

Lifecycle notifications like pipeline.started and connector.error are not returned by this endpoint — subscribe to them through the Webhooks endpoint instead.

}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Migrating from v2?|body_html=

v2 is no longer supported. See the v2 → v3 migration guide for breaking changes and upgrade steps.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • List events
  • Replay an event
    • }}

Webhooks endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}} {{ds:component/chip|label=Stable|variant=success}}

Subscribe to platform lifecycle events — such as pipeline.completed or connector.error — as outbound HTTP requests to a URL you control. This is the v2 replacement for v1's polling-only status checks; see the Migration guide if you're moving off v1.

Create a webhook subscription

POST /v2/webhooks

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=urlstringYesHTTPS endpoint Godzilla will POST events to.eventsarrayYesList of event types to subscribe to, e.g. ["pipeline.failed"].secretstringNoShared secret used to sign the X-Godzilla-Signature header. Auto-generated if omitted.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=webhook-payload.json|language=json|code={ "id": "evt_wh_2091", "type": "pipeline.failed", "occurred_at": "2026-08-18T09:14:02Z", "data": { "pipeline_id": "pl_ingest_orders", "error": "destination_timeout" } }}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Verify the signature|body_html=

Always verify X-Godzilla-Signature before trusting a webhook payload. Unsigned or unverifiable requests to your endpoint should be rejected, not processed.

}}

Delivery retries

A webhook delivery that doesn't receive a 2xx response is retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours, then marked failed. Failed deliveries are visible per-subscription and can be manually redelivered.

{{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Create a webhook subscription
  • Delivery retries
    • }}

Connectors endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}} {{ds:component/chip|label=Stable|variant=success}}

Manage connectors — the source and destination integrations pipelines read from and write to.

Create a connector

POST /v2/connectors

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=typestringYesOne of postgres, s3, snowflake, kafka, webhook.directionstringYessource, destination, or bidirectional (webhook only).configobjectYesType-specific connection details, e.g. connection string or IAM role ARN.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-connector.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/connectors \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "type": "postgres", "direction": "source", "config": { "connection_string": "postgres://..." } }'}}

Rotate credentials

POST /v2/connectors/{id}/rotate — pauses every pipeline referencing this connector for the duration of the rotation, then resumes them automatically.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Shared connectors|body_html=

A connector referenced by multiple pipelines is rotated once, for all of them. Check a connector's pipeline_count field before rotating during a busy window.

}}

Health status

GET /v2/connectors/{id} returns a health field of healthy, degraded, or down.

{{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Create a connector
  • Rotate credentials
  • Health status
    • }}

Transforms endpoint {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}} {{ds:component/chip|label=Stable|variant=success}}

Create and manage transform steps within pipelines. Transform steps are applied in order between source and destination connectors to filter, map, or enrich events.

Create a transform

POST /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms

{{ds:component/parameter-table|rows_html=pipeline_idstringYesID of the pipeline to add the transform to.namestringYesHuman-readable name for the transform step.typestringYesOne of filter, map, enrich, or aggregate.configobjectYesType-specific configuration, e.g. filter predicates or mapping rules.positionintegerNoPosition in the transform chain. If omitted, appends to the end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_123abc/transforms \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "filter-premium-orders", "type": "filter", "config": { "predicate": "event.amount > 100" } }'}}

List transforms

GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms — returns an ordered array of transform steps configured for the pipeline.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_123abc/transforms \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}}

Transform order and execution

Transforms are executed sequentially in the order they appear in the pipeline. Events flow left-to-right: source → transform[0] → transform[1] → ... → destination. Reorder transforms by updating a pipeline's transforms array directly.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Transform failures|body_html=

If a transform step fails (e.g. due to a malformed predicate), the event is logged as an error and does not flow to the destination. Review pipeline logs for details.

}}

Transform types

Filter

Exclude events matching a predicate. Events that do not match are passed through unchanged.

Map

Transform event fields using a mapping expression. Commonly used to rename, nest, or flatten fields.

Enrich

Add new fields to an event by joining with external data or applying a lookup.

Aggregate

Combine multiple events into a single event over a time window or count-based trigger.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Testing transforms|body_html=

Test your transform configuration against sample events before deploying to a live pipeline. Use the pipeline preview endpoint to validate the transform chain end-to-end.

}} {{ds:component/docs-toc|items_html=
  • Create a transform
  • List transforms
  • Transform order and execution
  • Transform types
    • }}

If omitted, appends to the end.}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-transform.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_123abc/transforms \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "filter-premium-orders", "type": "filter", "config": { "predicate": "event.amount > 100" } }'}}

List transforms

GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/transforms — returns an ordered array of transform steps configured for the pipeline.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-transforms.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X GET https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines/pipe_123abc/transforms \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}}

Transform order and execution

Transforms are executed sequentially in the order they appear in the pipeline. Events flow left-to-right: source → transform[0] → transform[1] → ... → destination. Reorder transforms by updating a pipeline's transforms array directly.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Transform failures|body_html=

If a transform step fails (e.g. due to a malformed predicate), the event is logged as an error and does not flow to the destination. Review pipeline logs for details.

}}

Transform types

Filter

Exclude events matching a predicate. Events that do not match are passed through unchanged.

Map

Transform event fields using a mapping expression. Commonly used to rename, nest, or flatten fields.

Enrich

Add new fields to an event by joining with external data or applying a lookup.

Aggregate

Combine multiple events into a single event over a time window or count-based trigger.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=warning|title=Testing transforms|body_html=

Test your transform configuration against sample events before deploying to a live pipeline. Use the pipeline preview endpoint to validate the transform chain end-to-end.
